title: ChallengeResponse
description: device -> server, replies to a challenge. signature is the base64-encoded ASN.1 DER ECDSA signature (SHA256withECDSA, matching Android Keystore's default EC signing output) over the raw bytes of the challenge's nonce after base64-decoding it — not over the nonce's base64 text. The server verifies against the public key stored at registration (device-registration.schema.json) for this connection's device_id and either sends welcome or closes the connection.
